heightCaveat.young: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 150 pc, for diffuse light; knots retain their measured sky-width prior
heightCaveat.gas: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 150 pc, for diffuse gas; knots retain their measured sky-width prior
heightCaveat.dust: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 250 pc; Bell column budget unchanged

sourceRole: Photo supplies spatial emission and dust-lane detail. Surveys are checks; Bell also fixes one dust amount.

method.stellarLibrary: BC03 / Chabrier / Z=0.008, preserved Johnson BVR integrations
method.gasMeaning: Hydrogen recombination color prior. Metal lines and the photo passbands remain uncertain; only global component grades can adjust this.
method.law: Gordon 2003 LMC average Rv=3.41; B/V measured ratio, R-band optical proxy

gasColorCalibration.reason: Unknown publisher passbands and processing, and missing metal lines in the pure hydrogen prior. This is a single color grade per component, applied before classification.

method.dustProxy: Fixed dark-lane contrast and local red/blue excess along the Gordon reddening direction, weighted by available illumination, plus an unresolved floor. Bell normalizes one total column budget. Not a measured dust-depth map.

thicknessStatus.young: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 150 pc, for diffuse light; knots retain their measured sky-width prior
thicknessStatus.gas: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 150 pc, for diffuse gas; knots retain their measured sky-width prior
thicknessStatus.dust: Adopted Gaussian sigma, 250 pc; Bell column budget unchanged

method.extension: 64-source-pixel smooth fade into the accepted old stellar paper profile. Young, gas and dust beyond the photo remain unsupported, as in l8. Non-converged or ambiguous warp projection branches revert smoothly to the paper profile. The boundary young/old ratio is a diagnostic only.

split.method: One fixed 3 by 3 spectral inverse per observed pixel, negative-cone clipping and algebraic total-light conservation. No local optimization.

method.geometry: The diffuse fields remain in the accepted Choi/Oden disc coordinates. Each compact source has a finite, shrinking three-dimensional cross section around its observed position and warped-plane centre. The bar is an analytic triaxial ellipsoid, not a repeated photo.
method.cloudDefinition: Deterministic watershed of compact photo emission. Each region has its measured on-sky RMS width, including finite pixel areas, as its line-of-sight RMS depth. Compact quartic cross sections shrink towards their 3D boundary. Region centres are on the accepted warped mid-plane. Flux is subtracted before replacement; no regional fitting.

cloudSegmentation.status: Fixed global image-segmentation choices, not measured individual memberships or fitted parameters. All native pixels within a complex retain their light.

youngDepth.status: Adopted by the owner, not a measurement or fit.

barDepth.status: Kacharov 2024 section 5.2 gives only qz <= 0.35, not a measured best thickness. Adopt the upper allowed value as an explicit choice. Keep Rathore placement and Kacharov planar axes. OGLE 2016 finds no significant global vertical offset.
